customer_question: We need to confirm the Review page before Submission. Also, is a model name with a trailing period (e.g., '19AVNJ.') acceptable for SIG registration?
question_variants: Can we submit if the model name ends with a period?
How do we confirm the Review page after corrections are made?
actual_issue: After corrections were made to the Qualification Workspace (HFP version fix and model name update from the previous thread), the consultant re-captured the Review page and sent it to AlpsAlpine for re-confirmation before Submission. The customer also asked whether a model name ending with a trailing period (e.g., '19AVNJ.') is acceptable for SIG registration. Confirmation: SIG accepts model names with trailing periods.
plain_english_explanation: Before submitting to SIG, it is standard procedure to send the customer a screenshot of the Qualification Workspace Review page so they can confirm all details are correct. If corrections were made (as in this case, for HFP version and model name), the consultant takes a fresh Review page screenshot and sends it again for re-confirmation. Once the customer approves, they instruct the consultant to submit. Separately, model names with trailing periods or punctuation are acceptable in SIG Launchstudio — SIG does not reject them.
consultant_answer: Re-captured the Review page after HFP version fix and model name update. Sent to AlpsAlpine for re-confirmation. Customer confirmed OK and instructed Submission. Model name with trailing period (e.g., '19AVNJ.') is acceptable in SIG registration.
decision_logic:
1. After any correction to the Qualification Workspace, re-capture the Review page and re-send to customer.
2. Wait for explicit customer confirmation ('OK, please submit') before submitting.
3. Model names with trailing periods are acceptable — no change required.
final_recommendation: After any correction, always re-send the updated Review page for customer confirmation. Do not submit based on prior approval if changes were made. Trailing periods in model names are not a reason to delay or modify.
risk_if_done_wrong: Submitting without re-confirming the Review page after corrections risks submitting incorrect information that the customer never approved. Changing an acceptable model name unnecessarily introduces additional delays.
